ns2:section.sectionText: Exploring Sexual Identity dialogue This course offers students an opportunity to explore and examine the experiences and perspectives of those with various sexual identities and orientations through readings, multimedia, and dialogue. Through collaborative sense-making, students will build their understanding of what these identities mean for them and their relationships with others. Meets 21 March 2022- 4-May-2022. OIIR Dialogue Course. 1 Hour (letter-graded) credit. Topic: Exploring Sexual Identity dialogue. Second half session class. Offered in collaboration with the Office of Inclusion and Intercultural Relations (OIIR). Go to website http://go.illinois.edu/EPSY203 for more detailed descriptions of the classes. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can email diversityed@illinois.edu
